Bill.BriefDescription: Directing a study of night parking for commercial vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a study of commercial vehicle parking; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislative transportation committeeshall conduct a feasibility study of the potential for local governmententities, including but not limited to port districts, to providelocations for parking commercial motor vehicles as defined in RCW46.04.140, at night. The study must, at a minimum: (1) Identify the factors that should be examined in determining thebest locations for parking commercial motor vehicles at night; (2) Apply the identified factors to an analysis of potentiallocations; (3) Recommend the best locations for parking commercial motorvehicles at night that can be provided by local government entities,including but not limited to port districts. The entity selected to perform the study through the request for p. 1 SB 6366proposals process shall report back to the transportation committees ofthe legislature by December 1, 2004.
